description: Verify that Subscribe → StopSubscribe → Subscribe — DUT Acks both subscribes
approach:
[Objective]
Cycle: subscribe, unsubscribe, resubscribe — DUT must Ack both subscribes (state cleanup between is implicit).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Subscribe → Ack #1.
3. StopSubscribe.
4. Subscribe → Ack #2.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_first_ack: No first Subscribe Ack within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_second_ack: No second Subscribe Ack after Stop within listen window
